en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small alpine village nestled in a valley surrounded by forested hills and terraced fields. In the middle of the settlement stands a prominent white church with a tall, slender spire and clock on its tower. Evergreen trees frame the foreground, and scattered farmhouses dot the slopes in the background. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
